instrument: Copernicus GloFAS v4.0, LISFLOOD, river discharge in the last 24 hours, 0.05 degree
floor_note: Cells whose peak flow is below the floor are omitted. They are not dry, they are below the drawable-reach floor.
rise_note: rise_x_first_day compares each cell against ITS OWN first day of this window. It is a within-window rise, NOT a multiple against the historical record. Only the anchors carry a record multiple.
